entry.title: Daily digest · Thu 19 Nov 2026
entry.summary: GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol (API, Codex, Bedrock) · agent-framework PyPI compromise · mcp-server-git RCE fixes · Claude Code ≥ 2.1.325
entry.content: 1. **Security, act now:** Microsoft's **`agent-framework` 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 on PyPI shipped a credential stealer** (2026-11-17). Pin 1.26.0, check for the `.pth` files and rotate secrets on affected hosts. Also upgrade the reference **`mcp-server-git` to 2026.11.18** (malicious repo Git config could run programs). 2. **OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol** (`gpt-6.2-astra`, `gpt-6.2-sol`) are out on the API, in Codex, and on Bedrock. Astra lists at $8/$40 per 1M tokens, down from GPT-6 Astra's $10/$50. A new background mode is 30–40% cheaper if you can wait 2–8 hours. 3. **Upgrade Claude Code to ≥ 2.1.325.** Releases 2.1.321–2.1.325 fix an MCP OAuth token leak and several sandbox/Bash permission gaps. Sandboxed Bash now prompts by default, so check unattended runs. 4. **MCP SDKs:** the TypeScript SDK has four CVEs (fixed in `sdk` 1.32.0 / `server` 2.3.0) and mcp-go has a token-replay bug (fixed in v1.2.1). 5. **Action items:** add `--trust` to CI jobs using `codex exec` with repo config (Codex 0.169) · Pydantic AI 2.60 changed how tool retries are reported · new AgentCore runtimes now default to V2, so set `platformVersion` explicitly · Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires **30 Nov** · Gemini 4 Argon doubles **1 Dec**.

entry.title: Daily digest · Wed 18 Nov 2026
entry.content: 1. **Claude Fable 5.2** is GA on paid plans, the API and Bedrock ($8/$40 per 1M tokens), and **Gemini 4 Carbon** is GA. Kimi K3.1 Pro and Mistral Large 4 shipped **open weights**. 2. New controlled studies show **multi-agent committees mostly add cost**. Reasoning effort, goal checks, spec-first TDD and lean harnesses are what help. 3. **Success story of the year so far:** Ramp's background coding agent Inspect writes about **3 in 4 merged PRs**. It works because the agent verifies its own work in one sandbox per session. 4. The **MCP 2026-07-28 stateless spec** is the baseline. Migrate remote servers; Spring AI 2.0 supports `protocol=STATELESS`. 5. **Action items:** Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires on **30 Nov** · Gemini 4 Argon doubles in price on **1 Dec** · upgrade Claude Code to **≥ 2.1.319** · **AWS re:Invent runs 30 Nov – 4 Dec**. 6. **Repo news:** the repo is reorganised into five groups (Build, Models, Architecture, Platforms, Learn), with a new [architecture hub](../../../architecture/README.md) and a [successful projects](../../../learn/successful-projects/README.md) showcase.
